record.source_text:
The register shall contain, under the precise designation of each individual fixed asset:  
— date of acquisition,  
— acquisition or production costs,  
— name and address of the supplier,  
— estimated useful life,  
— amount of annual depreciation, and  
— the remaining depreciable amount (residual book value).
